playbookOutputs: UIF employer reference number (commercial employer, U-number)
uFiling employer profile activated with employees declared
Guidance note on monthly UI-19 declarations and contributions
playbookCommonFailures: Employer already has a UIF reference through SARS PAYE registration, so a second registration is refused as a duplicate
Employee details incomplete — missing ID numbers, start dates or gross salaries for one or more employees
Certified director ID older than 3 months
Business bank account details in a director's name or a transaction statement instead of a confirmation letter
Proof of business address older than 3 months or only a PO Box

informationToProvide.label: Certified copy of company registration documents (e.g., CIPC CoR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and directors. The catalogue asks for a certified copy — accept an uncertified CIPC-issued PDF but flag it for Kevin if the Department insists on certification.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all directors/members
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified copy of the ID (both sides of a smart card) for every director on the CoR14.3, certified within the last 3 months with a legible stamp, signature and date.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address (utility bill)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account or lease showing the physical business address, dated within 3 months, in the company's name.

informationToProvide.label: Business bank account details
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the COMPANY's name, dated within 3 months, with bank stamp or digital verification reference. A statement is not acceptable.

informationToProvide.label: Details of employees (ID numbers, salaries, start dates)
informationToProvide.aiHint: List of every employee with full name, SA ID or passport number, date of engagement, gross monthly salary and hours per month. Working directors who draw a salary are included. Needed for the UI-19 declaration that follows the employer registration.

informationToProvide.label: SARS PAYE / UIF reference number (if the company is already registered for PAYE)
informationToProvide.aiHint: If SARS has issued a PAYE number, the UIF reference is usually the same number with a 'U' prefix. Ask before registering afresh to avoid a duplicate employer record.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect UIF registration requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every required document uploaded and the employee list complete for all employees
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing; explain that the Department of Employment and Labour needs the company's own bank letter and address, and a complete employee list to declare contributions. Ask up front whether the company is registered for PAYE with SARS — if so, the UIF reference may already exist and this becomes a uFiling activation rather than a new registration. Ask for the date the first employee started. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 30–60 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against UIF requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; employee list has no blank ID, salary or start date
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The employer is the company, never the ordering contact. CoR14.3, bank letter and proof of address in the company's name. Director names must match the certified IDs; certification within 90 days. Validate every employee ID number with the SA ID checksum and flag foreign passport holders (they need a passport number and work permit detail). Extract enterprise number, PAYE number if any, physical address, contact person, bank details, employee count and first-employee date.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare UI-8 / UI-19 values hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every employer registration (UI-8) field and the employee declaration (UI-19) rows posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Set out the UI-8 employer registration fields (employer name, trading name, CIPC number, PAYE number, physical/postal address, contact person, bank details, date of first employment, nature of business) and a UI-19 table of employees (ID number, surname, initials, date engaged, gross remuneration, hours). ⚠ verify: the commercial employer form is UI-8; domestic employers use UI-8D. Never invent a start date — leave blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Register employer and declare employees on uFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Employer registered (or activated) on uFiling and UI-19 declaration captured; reference number recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: ⚠ CHANNEL: plan §4.3 marks UIF ⚠ — confirm with Kevin whether commercial employers are registered online via uFiling (www.ufiling.co.za) or by emailing the UI-8 and UI-19 with attachments to the Department's employer registration mailbox. uFiling sends an OTP / activation email to the employer's contact details, so this step cannot be completed without the client. If the company already has a PAYE number, activate the existing U-number on uFiling instead of creating a new employer. Save the confirmation screen and the reference to the order.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for the Department to confirm the UIF reference
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: UIF employer reference number confirmed in writing or on the uFiling profile
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a status query to the Department quoting the submission reference and CIPC number at each follow-up point. If the Department returns the application for missing employee details, create a proposal for Kevin and a client message naming the exact employee and field.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver UIF reference and next-steps note to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: UIF reference and confirmation posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the reference number and confirmation. Explain in plain English that a UI-19 declaration is due monthly and that contributions (1% employee + 1% employer) are paid via SARS EMP201 where PAYE-registered, otherwise directly to the Fund. Offer the monthly payroll / EMP201 service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
